links.outcome: Patient-rated helpfulness of generic LLM chatbot use in self-reported personal crisis situations
links.effect: 61.4% (121/197) used LLM-CBs in personal crisis; 67.7% (82/121) found the experience unhelpful, though crisis use experienced as helpful was rated positively.
links.quote: In total, 61.4% (121/197) have used LLM-CBs in self-reported personal crisis situations, of whom, 67.7% (82/121) found the experience unhelpful.

unlisted_practices: Asking patients about LLM chatbot use during psychosocial assessment in mental health care

screen.reason: Empirical cross-sectional mixed methods survey examining real-world usage, benefits, and harms of generic LLM chatbots by mental health outpatients.
